senses.gloss: m. (redupl. of טָמַם) a person whose genitals are hidden, or undevelopped; one whose sex is unknown.
units: B. Bath. 126ᵇ ט׳ שנקרע וכ׳ a tumtum who was operated upon and was found to be a male.

Prov. 953</cite> <he>ט׳ הוא העולם</he>, v. <cite ref="A00091"><he>אַבְטוֹמְטוֹס</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>טוּמְטוּמִין</he>.
